description: Room left rounds down to 6 decimals (money stage 1, item 5a). imd-flop: rounding.ts floor6(value). viewer: build-lane.py floor6(value), which spend_limit uses for what is left of each limit. A value within 1e-12 of a 1e-6 boundary counts as on it, so float noise never moves a 6 decimal amount below 8192 FLOP. Rounding never adds room: before this file the viewer rounded room left to nearest, so a row over its limit by less than 1e-6 FLOP was not flagged.
